'''Anakkonas''' were enormous snakes that lived on the forest floors of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. They were among the infamous predators feared by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. Following his escape from [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Faie/Legends|Faie]], [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] encountered an anakkona that he willed to eat [[Bogey 5632]], a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] member of [[Bogey Squad]]. The trick was based on an experience Vos had in which [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] demonstrated mental control over a [[Greater krayt dragon/Legends|greater krayt dragon]].
